_fixture_note: Synthetic ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 studies, shaped exactly like real API v2 `study` objects (see backend/app/ingestion/normalize.py's normalize_trial and tests/fixtures/ctgov_study_sample.json), authored for Phase 6 evaluation only. All five NCT ids (NCT9000000{1..5}) are placeholders in an unused ID range, not real trials. The drugs 'TL-101'/'TL-205' and conditions 'Stage III Fictional Carcinoma'/'Relapsed Fictional Lymphoma' are entirely fictional so this corpus can carry ground-truth facts (used to compute real Recall@5/MRR/citation metrics) without representing any real clinical result. Each trial's brief_summary + detailed_description is kept under ~500 characters so it chunks into exactly one Chunk row (chunk_size=1000 in app/retrieval/config.py) — that keeps 'the right answer is in document X' unambiguous for evaluation, rather than depending on which half of a longer document got chunked where.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of TL-101 in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of TL-101 in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates whether TL-101 improves overall survival compared to placebo in adults with Stage III Fictional Carcinoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive TL-101 or matching placebo. The primary endpoint was overall survival at 24 months, and the study met its primary endpoint. The most common adverse event was fatigue, reported in 34% of participants receiving TL-101.

primaryOutcomes.description: Time from randomization to death from any cause, assessed at 24 months.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from randomization to disease progression or death.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of TL-101 Plus Chemotherapy in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Single-Arm Study of TL-101 in Combination With Chemotherapy in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This single-arm study evaluates the objective response rate of TL-101 combined with standard chemotherapy in adults with Stage III Fictional Carcinoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: All participants received TL-101 in combination with standard chemotherapy. The objective response rate (ORR) was 48%, assessed by independent radiologic review.

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants achieving a complete or partial response by independent radiologic review.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Dose-Escalation Study of TL-205 in Adults With Relapsed Fictional Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1, Open-Label, Dose-Escalation Study of TL-205 in Adults With Relapsed Fictional Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This dose-escalation study determines the maximum tolerated dose of TL-205 in adults with relapsed fictional lymphoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants received escalating doses of TL-205 in a standard 3+3 design. The maximum tolerated dose (MTD) was determined to be 200mg.

primaryOutcomes.description: Highest dose at which no more than 1 of 6 participants experiences a dose-limiting toxicity.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of TL-101 in Children With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Open-Label Study of TL-101 in Pediatric Patients With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates the safety and pharmacokinetics of TL-101 in pediatric patients with Stage III Fictional Carcinoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants aged 2 to 17 years receive TL-101 at a weight-based dose. This study is currently recruiting and has not yet reported results.

primaryOutcomes.description: Safety and tolerability of TL-101 in pediatric participants.

identificationModule.briefTitle: An Observational Study of Long-Term Outcomes in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma Treated With TL-101
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 4, Observational, Post-Marketing Study of Long-Term Outcomes in Adults With Stage III Fictional Carcinoma Treated With TL-101

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This observational study evaluates five-year survival rates in adults with Stage III Fictional Carcinoma treated with TL-101 in real-world clinical practice.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants who received TL-101 as part of routine clinical care are followed for five years. The primary endpoint is the five-year survival rate.

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants alive five years after starting TL-101.
